**Sundhedsklynge Syd** is a healthcare cluster operating within [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] in Denmark. It is frequently evaluated in the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) annual quality reports concerning the treatment and monitoring of [[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]] (atrial fibrillation) in the Danish healthcare system. 

In the 2024 AFDK report, which analyzes data from July 2021 to June 2023, Sundhedsklynge Syd's clinical performance was tracked across multiple quality indicators. Notably, the cluster failed to meet the national standard of 90% for Indicator 1, which measures the timely initiation of anticoagulation therapy in newly diagnosed patients, achieving a result of 89.9% [^src1]. Furthermore, the cluster recorded the lowest proportion among its peers for [[indikator-4a2|Indikator 4a2]] (2-year treatment coverage), scoring 84.3% (95% CI: 80.6–87.6) [^src2]. 

The cluster's data is also integral to broader epidemiological and geographic analyses within the report. For instance, it is included in the national mapping of the incidence of ischemic stroke (apoplexy) under [[indikator-5|Indikator 5]] [^src4]. Additionally, Sundhedsklynge Syd's outcomes are continuously monitored for severe bleeding within one year of a new diagnosis, heart failure development, and mortality rates, with data consistently stratified to allow for regional and local benchmarking across Danish healthcare clusters [^src5] [^src6] [^src7].
